title: Notice requirement.
bodyText: Thirteen months prior to discontinuation of writing property insurance coverage, an insurer shall file an affidavit with the commissioner stating the reasons for the discontinuation.
bodyHtml:
[PART IV.]  COVERAGES

 

     [§431:10E-151]  Notice requirement.  Thirteen months prior to discontinuation of writing property insurance coverage, an insurer shall file an affidavit with the commissioner stating the reasons for the discontinuation. [L 2016, c 141, pt of §1]
